item.description: Nvidia is said to be weighing a plan to halve the memory that goes into Rubin Ultra, its 2027 accelerator. The idea is to bring a chip that was to carry 384GB down to 192GB. TrendForce said much the same thing in a report dated July 31. Nvidia is still weighing four possible configurations, and what settles the final spec is not a performance target but how the memory makers allocate their wafers…

item.dc:creator: The Kobeissi Letter (@KobeissiLetter)
item.description: Eight numbers from last week's Kobeissi Letter, lined up in a row. Apart they are separate stories. Side by side they point the same way.
